name: War In Israel
overview: Scripture reveals that war in Israel is both a reality and a divine judgment, as seen in God's ongoing conflict with Amalek and the call to trust Him in battle despite overwhelming odds. While Ecclesiastes acknowledges a time for war, the prophetic vision in Isaiah points forward to a future when God will bring lasting peace, turning weapons into tools for cultivation. Jesus emphasizes the blessedness of peacemakers, even as He warns of wars and rumors of wars preceding the end times, reminding believers not to be troubled but to remain steadfast in faith.
